timezone_note: All fixture times are shown exactly as published by the league, with the league's own time-zone label. No conversion is applied.
params_note: Every parameter is a stated assumption, not a fitted value from bookmaker prices. Changing one changes every price on the site; the build records the version used.
method: Ratings come only from official league tables: goals for and against per game (NHL) pulled toward the league mean by a stated shrinkage, plus a fixed home edge, converted to a win probability with a logistic curve. Prices are no-vig fair odds derived from that probability. No bookmaker price is read, stored or reproduced.
limits: The NHL sample is 7-11 games per club, so ratings are heavily shrunk toward the mean.
The NBA sample is zero games, so every NBA line is an explicit baseline.
No line is originated for a market when its inputs are missing; the cell stays blank and is flagged.
Prices are fair odds with no margin and are not betting advice.
